name: NANO Nuclear Energy

logo.source: nanonuclearenergy.com site header logo (NANO-Nuclear-logoHorizontal-1280x374.png, white wordmark on transparent); no Wikipedia page exists. Saved composited on near-black (#0B0B0B) with padding, 1400x494, because the official wordmark is white and would vanish on a light page

description: NANO Nuclear is a pre-profit development company working on small advanced nuclear reactors and the fuel supply around them. Its lead project is the KRONOS MMR, a high-temperature gas-cooled microreactor using TRISO fuel, which it bought from the bankrupt Ultra Safe Nuclear in January 2025; a construction permit application for a first unit at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign was accepted by the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission on May 18, 2026. It is also trying to build a HALEU and low-enriched uranium fuel business, a nuclear fuel transportation business and nuclear consulting. It had no revenue until it bought Secured Transportation Services on May 22, 2026, which added $214 thousand in the quarter ended June 30, 2026, against a nine-month net loss of $25.8 million funded by stock sales (cash and short-term investments of about $580 million at June 30, 2026).

hq.note: Cover page of the FY2025 10-K: Times Square, 30th Floor, New York, NY 10018 (street number not captured by the text copy)

employees.note: 36 full-time employees plus 26 independent contractors (FY2025 10-K); later headcount not read

businessLines.name: Nuclear Reactor Business (KRONOS MMR, LOKI MMR, ZEUS, ODIN)
businessLines.how: Nothing yet. The plan is to sell the reactors it develops and to sell most of the power the first KRONOS unit produces at UIUC (the university keeps a share), with ODIN's sale proceeds and future royalties as a small offset.
businessLines.description: Develops microreactors: KRONOS MMR (high-temperature gas-cooled, TRISO fuel; principal focus), LOKI MMR, ZEUS and ODIN (portable modular low-pressure coolant reactor, being sold). First KRONOS unit planned at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, with the Chalk River site in Canada also pursued through the True North Nuclear (formerly GFPL) subsidiary.

businessLines.name: Fuel Processing Business (HALEU Energy Fuel)
businessLines.how: Nothing yet. The plan is to sell nuclear fuel (for its own reactors and for other advanced reactor developers) from facilities it intends to build or buy.
businessLines.description: Through HALEU Energy Fuel Inc., aims to build a US low-enriched uranium and high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) fuel supply chain: an investment and collaboration with LIST (a related party) on laser enrichment technology, an MOU with UrAmerica on Argentine uranium, and a September 28, 2026 agreement to buy Radnostix's (formerly International Isotopes) US nuclear fuel processing assets, including an NRC license and a planned depleted uranium hexafluoride deconversion plant site in Lea County, New Mexico.

businessLines.name: Fuel Transportation Business (Advanced Fuel Transportation, Secured Transportation Services)
businessLines.how: Fees from the acquired STS business (what it ships and how it bills was not read); the planned HALEU system would charge to move nuclear fuel for its own reactors and other nuclear companies once certified.
businessLines.description: Develops a high-capacity HALEU transportation system to be certified by the NRC, with a launch expected by 2028 (FY2025 10-K), and since May 22, 2026 owns Secured Transportation Services LLC (STS, Winder, Georgia), bought for up to $13.0M in total consideration ($6.0M cash, $1.0M stock at closing, $6.0M of stock in installments, with part tied to the seller staying employed).

revenue.period: Q3 FY2026 (three and nine months to 2026-06-30, all from the May 22 acquisition date)

businessLines.name: Nuclear Consultation Services
businessLines.how: Planned: fees for consulting work (regulatory advice, site assessment, roadmaps, stakeholder engagement) billed to nuclear and power customers.
businessLines.description: Nuclear service support and consulting, described in the FY2025 10-K as the nearest-term revenue opportunity; a small amount was generated through its support of the Digihost project. Not formally launched as of the 10-K; acquisitions under discussion.

brands.name: True North Nuclear (formerly Global First Power Ltd, holder of the Chalk River license application)
Advanced Fuel Transportation Inc. and Secured Transportation Services LLC
brands.share: 100% of the $214 thousand of revenue in Q3 FY2026

whatsNext.text: NRC review of the KRONOS construction permit application at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; company expects approval mid to late 2027 and first construction in the second half of 2027

Closing of the purchase of Radnostix's US nuclear fuel processing assets (NRC license SUB-1011, Lea County, New Mexico deconversion plant site and patents) for $9.5 million cash plus $4 million of stock, expected about 90 to 120 days after the September 28, 2026 agreement, subject to NRC consent and other approvals
Commercial launch of the HALEU fuel transportation business expected by 2028; sponsored research agreement with the University of Illinois terminates February 28, 2027 unless ended earlier
